question: Which of the following features is not characteristic of the Indus Valley Civilization (Harappan Civilization)?

options.text: Well-planned urban centers with grid patterns.
Use of iron tools for agriculture.
Advanced drainage and water management systems.
Presence of a Great Bath and granaries.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Use of iron tools for agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indus Valley Civilization (Harappan Civilization)** is one of the oldest known urban civilizations, existing from approximately **3300 BCE to 1300 BCE**.
 
• The civilization is known for its advanced urban planning, architectural features, and technological advancements.
 
• **Well-planned urban centers with grid patterns:** The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro were built on a grid system, with well-defined streets and organized structures. This statement is correct.
 
• **Use of iron tools for agriculture:** The Harappan Civilization did not use iron tools as it was a **Bronze Age civilization**. Instead, they relied on tools made of copper and bronze. Iron came into use much later during the **Vedic period**. This statement is incorrect.
